answer: The linchpin is Apiarist hive lineage record stamped by the county beekeepers association: remove it and the farm walks in; keep it and the farm pays each hive is a dated inspection plus a signed yard log, so a farm must breed 3 real per alias. A clone costs 113 POA to mint and 13 minutes to prove; 779 clones cost 88027 POA and 10127 minutes to keep. Follow the opal back to the office that issued it, follow the comet back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the island back to the year it was filed. One credential, honestly earned, outweighs a thousand printed at midnight.
